title: Before the dispute,
there was a contribution.
overview.deck: Demand, submitted work and the public response are distinct parts of this story.

title: Three threads.
One timeline.
timeline.deck: The three GitHub threads are ordered in Taiwan time (UTC+8), with expandable UTC comparisons. Facebook times have minute precision and are grouped with their replies in the archive; invented seconds are not used to mix them into this timeline.

title: Every statement,
in its context.
archive.deck: English editorial paraphrases, organized by GitHub thread and Facebook post. Original names, source IDs, timestamps and links are retained. These are not verbatim translations of all original posts.

title: Several questions
inside one dispute.
questions.deck: Arguments are compared without assigning unstated positions or equating one member’s comment with project-wide consensus.

title: What can be checked,
and where the record ends.
sources.deck: An independent record with capture cutoffs, not a TOML statement or a quality certificate for both translations.
